title: Bounds on Frobenius dimension
summary: In this article, we prove two types of results about the Frobenius dimension of associative algebras. First, we refine the known upper bound for the Frobenius dimension of a finite dimensional algebra in terms of its dimension as a vector space, and show that the only algebras reaching this bound are radical square zero algebras associated with single-vertex quivers. Second, we compute Frobenius dimension for low-dimensional algebras explicitly, and for truncated path algebras in terms of paths with no detours in their underlying quivers.
